text:
emma-sales: Heads-up — Acme POC still blocked. They get 403 from our SCIM endpoint when trying to provision into their Dedicated pool. Error body says "domain_not_allowed". Can eng advise?

toni-solutions: quick theory: their IdP is sending the email as user@eng.acme.com but the tenant only has acme.com verified. Platform rejects SCIM writes that don't match verified_domains for Dedicated tenants.

mike-okta: we're the IdP team for Acme. We mapped "Email" to `mail` in our Okta app but our profile has primaryEmail as user@eng.acme.com. We followed your docs but still blocked. Any specific claim names you expect?

sam-infra: thanks Mike. Two options: 1) add eng.acme.com to the tenant verified_domains, 2) change the SAML/SCIM mapping to use base domain. From a security/tenant isolation standpoint we prefer mapping on their side unless legal approves adding subdomain.

toni-solutions: also confirm SCIM payload format. We usually expect emails array with primary flag. Example we accept: 
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "tester@acme.com",
  "emails": [{"value": "tester@acme.com", "primary": true}]
}
```
If they send userPrincipalName only, SCIM may not pick it up depending on mapping.

nina-security: if we need to make a manual change (add verified domain) we must record approval and limit scope. We can also approve a temporary, scoped provisioning key (scim:users:create) with a 12h TTL for onboarding. That key must be logged and rotated.

emma-sales: Acme asked about a temporary manual onboarding path — can we do a console-based create of 5 admin users while they adjust IdP? They want POC up by Friday close of business. Also they're checking pricing for the Dedicated slot while we sort access.

sam-infra: console create is possible and safest short-term. I'll need a ticket to log the manual provisioning, and deploy-bot will capture the audit. If legal says no tenant config changes, we'll avoid adding domains.

mike-okta: mapping change is quick. Which attribute should we send as the primary email in SAML? We currently populate both `mail` and `userPrincipalName`.

toni-solutions: send `mail` as the primary email and ensure it's identical to emails[0].value in SCIM. For Okta: in the app profile map `Email` to user.mail and set it as the username. In SCIM, make sure the userName and emails[0].value match.

emma-sales: can someone dump a tiny checklist I can hand to their IdP folks? They want copy-paste instructions.

sam-infra: checklist to share:
 - Verify SAML assertion contains an `mail` attribute set to the user's email (example: user@acme.com).
 - Ensure SCIM user objects include `emails[0].value` and that it matches the SAML `mail`.
 - If users use a subdomain (eng.acme.com), either add that subdomain to tenant verified_domains or normalize to base domain on IdP side.
 - Use this curl test (mask token) and paste response for debugging: 
```bash
curl -si -X POST "https://scim.redwood.example/v2/Users" 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" 
 -d '{"userName":"probe@acme.com","emails":[{"value":"probe@acme.com","primary":true}]}'
```
 - If 403, include full JSON error body.

nina-security: I'll draft the temporary key process: generate scoped key (scope: scim:users.create), 12h TTL, single-use for console/API, mandatory rotation, and audit entry in ticket. I'll attach SOC2 docs and SCIM retention policy to their security questionnaire.

mike-okta: thanks. We'll try swapping the mapping to `mail` and re-run. If you can provide the exact error sample you see, that helps. Current error we got: { "status":403, "error":"domain_not_allowed", "message":"user domain eng.acme.com not permitted for tenant" }.

sam-infra: that's exactly the tenant verified_domains check. If Acme wants us to add eng.acme.com, we need legal approval. Emma, can you coordinate a sign-off?

emma-sales: looping in legal now. Also scheduling a 30-min mapping call with Acme IdP for 20m from now. Mike, please join.

deploy-bot: [audit] manual provisioning requested by emma-sales: create 5 admin users in tenant acme-tenant-123. Request id: RBW-5021. Status: pending approval (legal + infra).

mike-okta: on call. We'll try the mapping change first and report back in 15 mins.

toni-solutions: if they still hit 403 after mapping change, paste the full SCIM request/response (PII redacted) and we'll open a live debug session. Also note: some IdPs send a `username` claim that strips dots; ensure they don't rewrite the local part.

emma-sales: perfect. I'll update when we have confirmation. Thanks all. :handshake:
